integrity.scope: canonical JSON excluding the integrity object

limits.citation_scope_coverage: Actual cited passage/source counts are recorded per run; a zero count does not claim that citation scope was exercised.
limits.decision_breakdown: The safe receipts retain resolution counts and exact suggestion binding, not accepted/rejected totals.
limits.generation_failure_root_cause: A numeric-category failure and retry are observed; no rejected prose is retained or reconstructed.
limits.privacy: Only operational counts, closed diagnostic categories, booleans and recomputed hashes are included.
limits.unretained_identity_hashes: Run, report and snapshot identifiers were deleted with disposable data; their opaque hashes were not independently regenerated or included here.

provenance.source_manifest_digest_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON of the original safe receipt product_source_sha256 mapping, with sorted keys and compact separators.

scope: One local API execution of each fixed scenario on one unchanged source manifest; this is not a long-term reliability estimate or browser acceptance.
